content.description: TAC Cross Chain Layer is a cross-chain bridge. TAC is a purpose-built blockchain for EVM dApps to access TON and Telegram Ecosystem s 1B+ user base. It connects separate ecosystems so assets can move into or out of TON without a manual exchange path. TAC makes it seamless for Ethereum dApps to be deployed on TON. Those details make easily deploy hybrid dapps on ton, a shared vision, explore the latest on tac, and where vision meets execution part of the product story. TAC Cross Chain Layer is kept in this TON set because its product has a concrete user or builder workflow, not only a loose mention of the network.
